08-rna_protein_loglog_plot



library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)






# 8.1. Import data


data_dir <- "C:/Users/peter/OneDrive/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/data"
results_dir <- "C:/Users/peter/OneDrive/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/results"

# RNA VST matrix (genes x samples)
full_vsd <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "vst_oof.csv"),
  check.names = F,
  row.names = 1
)

# Protein log2-normalized abundance matrix (samples x proteins)
protein_mat <- read.csv(
  "C:/Users/peter/OneDrive/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/data/protein_mat.csv",
  check.names = F,
  row.names = 1
)






# 8.2. Prepare RNA


rna_mean <- data.frame(
  gene = rownames(full_vsd),
  mean_rna_vst = rowMeans(full_vsd, na.rm = T)
) %>%
  mutate(
    gene_symbol = ensg2gene$gene_symbol[
    match(gene, ensg2gene$X)
   ],
    gene_symbol = ifelse(
      is.na(gene_symbol),
      gene,
      gene_symbol
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(gene_symbol),
    gene_symbol != ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_rna_vst = mean(mean_rna_vst, na.rm = T),
    .groups = "drop"
  )






# 8.3. Prepare protein


protein_mean <- data.frame(
  gene_symbol = colnames(protein_mat),
  mean_protein_log2 = colMeans(
    protein_mat,
    na.rm = T
  )
) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(gene_symbol),
    gene_symbol != ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(gene_symbol) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_protein_log2 = mean(mean_protein_log2, na.rm = T),
    .groups = "drop"
  )






# 8.4. Merge RNA with protein


loglog_df <- inner_join(
  rna_mean,
  protein_mean,
  by = "gene_symbol"
)

# Identify highly abundant genes for labeling
label_df <- loglog_df %>%
  mutate(
    total_abundance = mean_rna_vst + mean_protein_log2
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_abundance)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

# Spearman correlation
cor_spearman <- cor(
  loglog_df$mean_rna_vst,
  loglog_df$mean_protein_log2,
  method = "spearman",
  use = "complete.obs"
)






# 8.5. Log-log abundance plot


min_x <- min(
  loglog_df$mean_rna_vst,
  na.rm = T
)

loglog_plot <- ggplot(
  loglog_df,
  aes(
    x = mean_rna_vst,
    y = mean_protein_log2
  )
) +

  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.25,
    size = 1,
    color = "grey30"
  ) +

  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    span = 0.75,
    se = TRUE,
    color = "firebrick",
    fill = "firebrick",
    alpha = 0.15,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  geom_text_repel(
    data = label_df,
    aes(label = gene_symbol),
    size = 3,
    fontface = "plain",
    max.overlaps = 20,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    segment.color = "grey70"
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(min_x, 15),
    ylim = c(min_x, 18)
  ) +

  theme_classic(
    base_size = 12,
    base_family = "Arial"
  ) +

  theme(
    text = element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 12,
      face = "plain"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 12,
      color = "black",
      face = "plain"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 12,
      color = "black",
      face = "plain"
    ),
    axis.line = element_line(
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 12,
      face = "plain",
      color = "black",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 12,
      face = "plain",
      color = "black",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(10, 15, 10, 10)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Mean RNA expression (VST)",
    y = expression("Mean protein abundance (log"[2]*")"),
    title = "RNA–Protein Abundance Relationship",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Spearman \u03C1 = ",
      formatC(
        cor_spearman,
        format = "f",
        digits = 2
      )
    )
  )


print(loglog_plot)


# Save editable vector PDF

ggsave(
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "RNA_protein_loglog_abundance.pdf"
  ),
  loglog_plot,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 6.5,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  bg = "white"
)
